project.name: PartLens
project.summary: A Windows desktop app that designs small electronics boards from an idea and reviews bills of materials: a local AI model investigates while deterministic engineering checks decide compatibility, and missing evidence stays unverified.

zetaris.how: Read-only Lightning SQL through the Zetaris REST (UI proxy) API over supplier observations. In 'Official JLCPCB through Zetaris' mode, official JLCPCB observations are queried as a relation and related to BOM lines and requirements, with no silent fallback. Every query is journalled with SQL, client request ID, timing, row count and a result digest.
evidence: docs/hackathon/SPONSOR-ACCESS.md: 88 successful SELECTs in the official-source trial; independent validation on 2026-10-22
Desktop 'Check local services' runs a real query restricted to the demo BOM's supplier codes and records whether matching rows came back

meterless.how: Meterless H-MEM is PartLens's decision memory. Each verified, rejected or unverified substitution decision is written with its run record, decision ID and checks. Recall brings decisions back in a new session as context, and the workflow controller forces the deterministic checks to run again on current data before reuse.
evidence: Bundled H-MEM reference engine (commit 1742dec56a66e58eef9dda2d2b865823758ca8cd) test suite: 10/10 passing
Cold-session recall rechecked 5 decisions: 3 unchanged, 2 still unverified
Packaged executable acceptance performs a real H-MEM write and cold recall

cursor.how: Cursor was not used. Development used Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity; none are in the product's runtime path.

nvidia.how: Local inference hardware: Ollama runs qwen3.5:9b (Q4_K_M, 6.1 GB) fully in the memory of an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (16 GB). No NVIDIA cloud API or Nemotron model is used.

pre_existing: Ollama runtime and Qwen qwen3.5:9b model weights (downloaded locally, not distributed)
Meterless H-MEM reference engine, commit 1742dec5 (Apache-2.0, vendored by setup)
pywebview, WebView2, Node.js and Python libraries (see THIRD_PARTY.md)
evidence_logs: Run records are written locally under %LOCALAPPDATA%\PartLens\state and are not distributed
